As per your request, please find below the 12-month rates for the following apartments:

1. The Residences W3 – Unit 601, Downtown Dubai

Property listing: https://www.propertyfinder.ae/en/plp/rent/apartment-for-rent-dubai-downtown-dubai-the-residences-the-residences-1-104124474.html

Total 12-month rate: AED 390,000
Monthly equivalent: AED 32,500

2. MAG318 – Business Bay

Property listing: https://www.propertyfinder.ae/en/plp/rent/apartment-for-rent-dubai-business-bay-mag-318-97378457.html

Total 12-month rate: AED 230,000
Monthly equivalent: AED 19,500

Please note that the booking will be processed on a monthly basis, with each month consisting of 30 nights.

A security deposit of AED 5,000 is required for both units.

*
Long-Stay Booking Terms:
*
To confirm and secure a long-term booking, the first month's rent, last month's rent, and security deposit must be paid in advance. Once the payment is received, we will be able to reserve the unit and secure the agreed rate for the confirmed booking period.

Please let us know which option you would prefer, and we will be happy to assist you with the next steps.

Thank you.
